title: Trump says Venezuela to turn over 30 to 50 million barrels of oil to US
description: Venezuela will be "turning over" 30 to 50 million barrels of sanctioned oil to the United States, President Donald Trump said on Tuesday in the aftermath of the toppling of Nicolas Maduro who was seized from his country by U.S. forces over the weekend.

title: Trump Announces Venezuela to Transfer 30-50 Million Barrels of Sanctioned Oil to United States
description: Trump announced that interim Venezuelan authorities will transfer 30-50 million barrels of high-quality sanctioned oil to the United States. This significant development involves substantial petroleum resources previously under international sanctions. The arrangement represents a notable shift in US-Venezuela energy relations and the management of Venezuelan oil assets.

title: Russia condemns US armed aggression against Venezuela at UN Security Council
description: NEW YORK, Jan. 5 : Russian UN ambassador Vassily Nebenzia said Monday that his country condemns the US military action against Venezuela over the weekend. “We firmly condemn the act of armed aggression by the United States against Venezuela in breach of all norms of international law,” Nebenzia told an emergency meeting of the Security Council following the U.S. assault on Venezuela. title: Mexico dismisses US military intervention despite Trump's threats after Venezuela operation
description: MEXICO CITY, Jan 6 : After the United States military intervention in Venezuela, the Mexican government and analysts discounted the likelihood of unilateral US military action against Mexican drug cartels, despite threats from President Donald Trump. Mexican President Claudia Sheinbaum’s administration has been complying with Washington’s demands and the economic ties between the two countries are vital, they say. title: CPI(M) protests against US Military Ops in Venezuela
description: Excelsior Correspondent JAMMU, Jan 6: The activists of CPI (M) today held a strong protest in Jammu to condemn the United States (US) Military operation in Venezuela and arrest of its President, Nicolas Maduro along with wife. Senior party leader and MLA Kulgam, Mohd Yousuf Tarigami was leading the protest.
